description: The bar chart illustrates a "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment." The horizontal axis displays the categorical models being evaluated, ordered from left to right as "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude," with the labels slightly rotated. The vertical axis represents the "Runtime (seconds)" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 400 with tick marks and horizontal dashed grid lines at regular intervals of 50. A legend in the upper left corner indicates that the dark green color corresponds to "Our Joint Framework," while the slate blue-grey color corresponds to "LLM Models." There are five vertical bars, each outlined in black and annotated with its exact numerical value in bold text directly above it. The bars are not sorted in a specific ascending, descending, or alphabetical order. The first bar, "Our Joint Framework," is dark green and represents the shortest runtime at 77 seconds. The remaining four bars are slate blue-grey, representing the various LLM models: "ChatGPT" has a runtime of 190 seconds, "DeepSeek" is the tallest bar with a runtime of 365 seconds, "LLaMA" has a runtime of 172 seconds, and "Claude" has a runtime of 243 seconds. Visual emphasis is applied through the distinct dark green coloring of the first bar to differentiate it from the others, alongside the bold numerical annotations provided for every category.
